envelope.description: Add the install, uninstall and status daemon methods

body.title: Add the install, uninstall and status daemon methods
body.summary: Add repo.gitHooks.install, repo.gitHooks.uninstall and repo.gitHooks.status: each refuses an unregistered repository, resolves the hooks directory with the typed git_rev_parse gitPath input, applies, removes or inspects the blocks for post-merge and post-rewrite through the block module, sets the gitHooks setting through the daemon's settings handler, and returns data without throwing. Register them in the handler table, the method-class table and the repository-call audit and extend the recorded handler key-set test.
acceptanceChecks: An unregistered repository and a path that is not a git repository are refused with a reason and nothing is written
Install writes both blocks and sets gitHooks true, a hook file that fails leaves the other installed and is reported, and uninstall removes the blocks and sets it false
The hooks directory comes from git_rev_parse and honours core.hooksPath, the three methods are in all three registries, and handler-runtime.test.ts records them

tests.name: src/daemon/__tests__/git-hooks-methods.test.ts: repo.gitHooks.install, uninstall and status refuse an unregistered repository, write only through the daemon, and keep the gitHooks setting equal to what is installed
src/daemon/__tests__/git-hooks-methods.test.ts: a failing hook file leaves the other hook installed and is reported with its reason
